must_answer.question: Is the model trained on customer records or only used on them?

options.label: Training only
options.description: Records feed model training but not inference.

options.label: Inference only
options.description: Records are scored by a pre-trained model.

options.label: Both
options.description: Records are used for training and for inference.

must_answer.default: Both training and inference on customer records.
must_answer.default_if_wrong: If training is out of scope, the Article 6 analysis collapses to inference only.
must_answer.rationale_md: Article 6(4) compatibility test applies only to further processing.

optional.question: How long are the records retained after scoring?
optional.default_if_wrong: A longer retention adds a storage-limitation issue the memo would have to answer.

default_assumptions_if_skipped: Processing covers both training and inference.
